{{#invoke:SWGcite|main}}<noinclude>[[Category:Game citation templates]]

==Usage==
Use this template when referencing content from ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. It is not to be used in the "Appearances" field, only in references.
*The '''exp''' field should be used if referencing an expansion:
**AED = ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided|An Empire Divided]]''
**JtL = ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|Jump to Lightspeed]]''
**RotW = ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|Rage of the Wookiees]]''
**TTE = ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|Rage of the Wookiees]]'' (deprecated)
**ToOW = ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|Trials of Obi-Wan]]''
**NGE = {{GalaxiesNGE}}
**SK = {{GalaxiesNGE}} (deprecated)
**TCOA = {{GalaxiesNGE}} (deprecated)
*The '''type''' field will produce different variations for use in referencing different parts of the game, such as the Quest or a Location. 
**The parameter within the quotation marks should be the title of the quest, point of interest, item, etc.
**The parameter before Quest denotes the specific faction, class, etc.
**The parameter that follows the quest title denotes what planet the quest occurs on.


Example usage:
:<code><nowiki>{{SWGcite|exp=|type=|parameter 1|parameter 2}}</nowiki></code>
